SGMH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walk in for 52 Posts - Complete Details

Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital (SGMH) Recruitment 2026 for 52 posts of Senior Resident. Candidates with MS/MD, DNB, PG Diploma Can attend the walkin. The Walk-in on 24-09-2026. For detailed information please visit SGMH official website, sgmh.delhi.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Interview Date : 24 September 2026
  • Interview Date : 24 September 2026
  • Walk-in Interview Date : 24 September 2026

Application Fee

  • Administrative Authority : Government of NCT of Delhi
  • Post Name : Senior Resident Doctor
  • Registration Time : 9:00 AM to 12:00 noon
  • Obstetrics and Gynaecology : 2
  • Anaesthesia : 5
  • General : 45 years
  • OBC : 3 years of relaxation
  • SC/ST : 5 years of relaxation
  • Pay Scale : Rs.67,700 to Rs.2,08,700
  • Registration Time : 9:00 AM to 12:00 noon
  • Registration Timing : 9:00 AM to 12:00 noon

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
